Title: Fewer than 1% of the HTTP requests fail over the whole soak run
Preconditions: The demo service https://quickpizza.grafana.com is reachable
Test Data: Default: 10 VUs for 30 min plus 2 min ramps. Report run: 3 VUs, 20 s hold, 5 s ramps (`-e VUS=3 -e RAMP=5s -e HOLD=20s`) - a short smoke of the soak script, NOT a real 30 minute soak
Steps: 1. Run `k6 run scripts/soak.js`. 2. Read the end-of-test summary.
Expected Result: Threshold `http_req_failed: rate<0.01` holds. Less than 1% of all HTTP requests failed.

Title: 95% of the requests answer in under 2000 ms over the whole soak run
Preconditions: The demo service https://quickpizza.grafana.com is reachable
Test Data: Default: 10 VUs for 30 min plus 2 min ramps. Report run: 3 VUs, 20 s hold, 5 s ramps (`-e VUS=3 -e RAMP=5s -e HOLD=20s`) - a short smoke of the soak script, NOT a real 30 minute soak
Steps: 1. Run `k6 run scripts/soak.js`. 2. Read the end-of-test summary.
Expected Result: Threshold `http_req_duration: p(95)<2000` holds. The 95th percentile of the request duration is under 2000 ms.
